oson: Tadbirkor yangi g'oyani topadi, reja tuzadi va uni hayotga tatbiq etadi.
Yaxshi mahsulot o'zini o'zi reklama qiladi. Mamnun mijoz buni do'stlariga ham aytadi.
Bozorda talab bor joyda taklif ham paydo bo'ladi. Shuning uchun xaridorni tingla.
Kichik do'kon ham to'g'ri boshqarilsa, katta korxonaga aylanishi mumkin.
Pulni tejash ham daromad topishning bir yo'li. Har oy ozgina jamg'arib bor.
Yaxshi so'z bilan boshlangan savdo uzoq davom etadi. Mijozga doim hurmat bilan qara.
Har bir katta biznes kichik g'oyadan boshlanadi. Muhimi, birinchi qadamni bugun qo'yish.
Daromad xarajatdan ko'p bo'lsa, korxona foyda ko'radi, kam bo'lsa zarar ko'radi.
Narx juda baland bo'lsa, xaridor boshqa do'konga ketadi. Narxni o'ylab belgila.
Sifatli xizmat mijozni yana qaytib kelishga undaydi. Doimiy mijoz esa barqaror daromad demakdir.
Soliq to'lash har bir tadbirkorning burchi. Halol biznes uzoq yashaydi.
Kredit olishdan oldin uni qanday qaytarishni yaxshilab hisoblab chiq.
Reklama mahsulotni tanitadi, ammo mijozni sifat ushlab qoladi.
Bank omonati jamg'armani inflyatsiyadan himoya qilishga yordam beradi.
Jamoa bilan ishlagan tadbirkor ko'proq ishni ulguradi, chunki har kim o'z vazifasini biladi.
orta: Biznes reja - bu kelajakdagi ishingizning xaritasi. Unda maqsad, mijozlar, xarajatlar va kutilayotgan daromad aniq yoziladi. Yaxshi reja tuzgan tadbirkor qiyin vaziyatda ham to'g'ri yo'lni topa oladi.
Raqobat bozorni rivojlantiradi. Har bir korxona mijozni jalb qilish uchun sifatni oshiradi, narxni kamaytiradi va yangi xizmatlar o'ylab topadi. Natijada eng ko'p foyda xaridorga tegadi.

Muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorlar muammoni imkoniyat deb biladi. Ular odamlarni nima qiynayotganini kuzatadi va shu muammoni hal qiladigan mahsulot yaratadi. Ko'plab mashhur kompaniyalar aynan shunday tug'ilgan.

Mijoz bilan muloqot qilishda sabr juda muhim. Uning fikrini oxirigacha tinglang, savollariga aniq javob bering va va'da qilgan ishingizni albatta bajaring. Ishonch bir kunda emas, yillar davomida qozoniladi.
Marketing faqat reklama emas. U mijozni tushunish, mahsulotni to'g'ri joyda va to'g'ri narxda taklif qilish, so'ng odamlar bilan doimiy aloqani saqlab turish san'atidir.
Startap - bu tez o'sishni maqsad qilgan yangi kompaniya. U odatda kichik jamoa bilan boshlanadi, g'oyani tezda sinab ko'radi va mijozlarning fikriga qarab mahsulotini doimo yaxshilab boradi.
Moliyaviy savodxonlik har bir inson uchun zarur. Daromad va xarajatni yozib borish, ortiqcha qarzdan qochish hamda jamg'armani to'g'ri joylash kelajakda katta xotirjamlik beradi.
Yaxshi rahbar buyruq bermaydi, balki ilhomlantiradi. U jamoasidagi har bir insonning kuchli tomonini ko'radi, unga ishonch bildiradi va hammani umumiy maqsad sari birga yetaklaydi.
Onlayn savdo kichik bizneslarga katta imkoniyat ochdi. Endi uyda tikilgan kiyim yoki qo'lda yasalgan buyumni ham ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali butun mamlakatga sotish mumkin.
Har qanday mahsulotning narxi uning tannarxi, raqobatchilar narxi va mijoz to'lashga tayyor bo'lgan summa asosida belgilanadi. Juda arzon narx ham, juda qimmat narx ham savdoga zarar qiladi.
Kichik biznes iqtisodiyotda muhim o'rin tutadi. U yangi ish o'rinlari yaratadi, aholini kerakli tovar va xizmatlar bilan ta'minlaydi hamda davlat byudjetiga soliq to'laydi.
Franshiza - tayyor brend va ish tizimidan haq evaziga foydalanish huquqi. Tadbirkor noldan boshlamaydi: nom, retsept va reklama tayyor bo'ladi, lekin brend egasiga muntazam to'lov qilinadi.
Investor pulni loyihaga kelajakda foyda olish umidida kiritadi. Shuning uchun u tadbirkordan aniq reja, bozor tahlili va pul qachon qaytishini ko'rsatadigan hisob-kitobni so'raydi.
Pul oqimi korxonaning yuragi hisoblanadi. Foyda qog'ozda yaxshi ko'rinsa ham, kassada naqd pul yetmasa, ish haqi va ijara vaqtida to'lanmaydi. Shuning uchun kirim va chiqim har kuni kuzatiladi.
Eksport mahalliy mahsulotni chet el bozorlariga olib chiqadi. U mamlakatga valyuta keltiradi, korxonalarni sifatni oshirishga undaydi va yangi ish o'rinlari yaratadi.
qiyin: Tannarxi 12 000 so'm bo'lgan mahsulotni 18 000 so'mdan sotsangiz, har bir donadan 6 000 so'm yalpi foyda olasiz. Oyiga 450 dona sotilsa, yalpi foyda 2 700 000 so'mni tashkil etadi; ijara (800 000 so'm) va boshqa xarajatlar chegirilgach, qolgan summa sof foyda bo'ladi.

Iqtisodchilar resurslarni to'rt guruhga ajratadi: yer (tabiiy boyliklar), mehnat (insonlarning jismoniy va aqliy kuchi), kapital (asbob-uskunalar, binolar, pul) va tadbirkorlik qobiliyati. Aynan tadbirkor qolgan uchtasini birlashtirib, yangi qiymat yaratadi.

Kredit olishdan oldin uchta savolga javob bering: 1) Bu pul daromad keltiradimi? 2) Oylik to'lov daromadimning 30 foizidan oshmaydimi? 3) Kutilmagan vaziyat uchun kamida 3 oylik zaxiram bormi? Javoblardan biri "yo'q" bo'lsa, shoshilmang.

Inflyatsiya yillik 10 foiz bo'lsa, bugun 100 000 so'mga olinadigan savat bir yildan keyin taxminan 110 000 so'm turadi. Shuning uchun jamg'armani shunchaki uyda saqlash emas, foizi inflyatsiyadan yuqori bo'lgan omonat yoki ishonchli investitsiyaga joylash maqsadga muvofiq.

Brend - bu faqat logotip yoki chiroyli nom emas. U mijozning ongida shakllangan taassurot: sifat, ishonch, xizmat ko'rsatish madaniyati va hatto qadoqning rangi ham shunga kiradi. Kuchli brend yaratish uchun yillar kerak, lekin bitta yomon xizmat uni bir kunda yo'qqa chiqarishi mumkin.

Elektron tijoratda konversiya muhim ko'rsatkich hisoblanadi: agar saytga 2 000 kishi kirib, ulardan 60 tasi xarid qilsa, konversiya 3 foizni tashkil etadi. Uni oshirish uchun sahifa tez ochilishi, rasmlar sifatli bo'lishi va to'lov jarayoni 3 qadamdan oshmasligi kerak.

Yangi biznesni ro'yxatdan o'tkazishda bir necha bosqich bor: nom tanlash, faoliyat turini aniqlash, soliq rejimini belgilash, bank hisob raqamini ochish va kerak bo'lsa litsenziya olish. Bugun bu bosqichlarning katta qismini davlat xizmatlari portali orqali onlayn bajarish mumkin.

Nonvoyxona kuniga 600 ta non pishiradi: bitta nonning tannarxi 2 500 so'm, sotish narxi esa 4 000 so'm. Demak, har bir nondan 1 500 so'm, kuniga 900 000 so'm, 30 kunda esa 27 000 000 so'm yalpi foyda olinadi (soliq va ish haqidan oldin).

SWOT-tahlil to'rt qismdan iborat: kuchli tomonlar (Strengths), zaif tomonlar (Weaknesses), imkoniyatlar (Opportunities) va tahdidlar (Threats). Birinchi ikkitasi korxonaning ichki holatini, keyingi ikkitasi esa tashqi muhitni tavsiflaydi. Puxta qilingan tahlil strategiya tanlashni osonlashtiradi.

Jamoaviy loyihada vazifalarni taqsimlash uchun RACI usulidan foydalaniladi: R (Responsible) - ishni bajaruvchi, A (Accountable) - natija uchun javobgar, C (Consulted) - maslahat beruvchi, I (Informed) - xabardor qilinuvchi. Bu usul "Kim nima qiladi?" degan savolga aniq javob beradi.

Zararsizlik nuqtasi - daromad barcha xarajatlarni to'liq qoplaydigan sotuv hajmi. Doimiy xarajatlar oyiga 6 000 000 so'm, bir dona mahsulotdan qoladigan qo'shimcha foyda 15 000 so'm bo'lsa, oyiga kamida 400 dona sotish kerak: 6 000 000 / 15 000 = 400.

Yalpi ichki mahsulot (YaIM) - mamlakatda bir yilda ishlab chiqarilgan barcha tovar va xizmatlarning bozor qiymati. Uning o'sishi iqtisodiyot rivojlanayotganini ko'rsatadi, lekin aholi farovonligini baholashda aholi jon boshiga to'g'ri keladigan YaIM ham hisobga olinadi.

Talab va taklif qonuniga ko'ra, narx oshganda xaridorlar kamroq sotib oladi, ishlab chiqaruvchilar esa ko'proq taklif qiladi. Talab va taklif egri chiziqlari kesishgan nuqtada muvozanat narxi (P) va muvozanat miqdori (Q) aniqlanadi.

Kassa hisoboti uch qismdan iborat: davr boshidagi qoldiq (2 500 000 so'm), kirim (14 300 000 so'm) va chiqim (12 900 000 so'm). Demak, davr oxiridagi qoldiq 3 900 000 so'mni tashkil etadi; uni har oy bankdagi hisob bilan solishtirib turish kerak.

Diversifikatsiya - xavfni kamaytirish usuli: barcha mablag'ni bitta loyihaga emas, bir nechta yo'nalishga taqsimlash. Masalan, 100 mln so'mning 40 foizi asosiy biznesga, 30 foizi omonatga, 20 foizi aksiyalarga, 10 foizi esa zaxira fondiga ajratilishi mumkin.

oson: Every big business starts with a small idea. The key is to take the first step today.
A good product sells itself. A happy customer will tell friends and family about it.
Profit is what remains after all costs are paid. Watch your costs every day.
An entrepreneur finds a new idea, makes a plan and turns that plan into real work.
When demand grows, prices tend to rise. Smart sellers watch the market closely.
A loyal customer is worth more than one big sale. Treat every buyer with respect.
Even a small shop can grow into a large company if it is managed well.
Saving money is also a way to earn. Put a little aside every single month.
A strong team helps a company grow, because each person knows their own job.
Taxes pay for roads, schools and hospitals. An honest business pays them on time.
Before you take a loan, make a clear plan for how you will pay it back.
Advertising makes a product known, but quality keeps the customers coming back.
A bank deposit helps protect your savings from inflation.
If the price is too high, buyers will go to another shop. Set your price with care.
A small business creates jobs and brings goods closer to the people who need them.
orta: A business plan is a map of your future company. It clearly describes your goals, customers, costs and expected profit. An entrepreneur with a good plan can find the right path even in hard times.
Competition makes markets better. To win customers, companies improve quality, lower prices and invent new services. In the end, the buyer is the one who gains the most.
Successful founders see every problem as an opportunity. They notice what bothers people and build a product that solves it. Many famous companies were born exactly this way.
Patience matters when you talk to a customer. Listen until the end, answer every question clearly and always keep your promises. Trust is earned over years, not in a single day.
Marketing is more than advertising. It is the art of understanding customers, offering the right product at the right place and price, and staying in touch with people over time.
A startup is a young company built for fast growth. It usually begins with a small team, tests its idea quickly and keeps improving the product based on customer feedback.
Financial literacy is useful for everyone. Write down your income and expenses, avoid needless debt and invest your savings wisely, and you will feel calm about the future.
A great leader inspires rather than commands. Such a leader sees the strengths of each team member, shows trust in them and leads the whole team toward a shared goal.
Online shopping has opened huge doors for small businesses. Clothes sewn at home or handmade crafts can now be sold across the whole country through social networks.
Small businesses play a key role in the economy. They create new jobs, supply people with the goods and services they need and pay taxes that support public services.
A franchise is the right to use a proven brand and business system for a fee. The owner does not start from zero: the name, the recipe and the marketing are ready, but regular payments are required.
An investor puts money into a project hoping to earn a profit later. That is why investors ask for a clear plan, a market analysis and a forecast of when their money will come back.
Cash flow is the heart of a company. Even when profit looks good on paper, a business cannot pay wages and rent without enough cash, so income and spending must be tracked every day.
Exports take local products to foreign markets. They bring foreign currency into the country, push companies to raise quality and create new jobs at home.
Supply and demand set most prices in a market economy. When a product becomes popular, sellers can charge more; when shelves are full and buyers are few, prices usually fall.
qiyin: If a product costs 12,000 soums to make and you sell it for 18,000, you earn a gross profit of 6,000 soums per unit. Selling 450 units a month brings 2,700,000 soums of gross profit; after paying rent (800,000 soums) and other expenses, what remains is your net profit.

Economists divide resources into four groups: land (natural wealth), labour (the physical and mental effort of people), capital (equipment, buildings and money) and entrepreneurship. It is the entrepreneur who combines the other three and creates new value.

Before taking a loan, answer three questions: 1) Will this money bring income? 2) Is the monthly payment below 30% of my income? 3) Do I have savings for at least 3 months in case something goes wrong? If any answer is "no", do not rush.

With annual inflation of 10%, a basket of goods that costs 100,000 soums today will cost about 110,000 a year from now. That is why it is smarter to keep savings in a deposit or a reliable investment whose return beats inflation, not under the mattress.

A brand is not just a logo or a catchy name. It is the impression formed in the customer's mind: quality, trust, service culture and even the colour of the package. Building a strong brand takes years, yet a single bad experience can ruin it in a day.

In e-commerce, conversion is a key metric: if 2,000 people visit a website and 60 of them make a purchase, the conversion rate is 3%. To raise it, pages must load fast, photos must be sharp, and checkout should take no more than three steps.

A SWOT analysis has four parts: Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threats. The first two describe the company's internal situation, while the last two describe its external environment. A careful SWOT makes choosing a strategy much easier.

To register a new business, you go through several steps: choose a name, define the type of activity, select a tax regime, open a bank account and, if required, obtain a licence. Today, most of these steps can be completed online through the public services portal.

The break-even point is the sales volume at which revenue covers all costs. If fixed costs are 6,000,000 soums a month and each unit earns 15,000 soums above its variable cost, you must sell at least 400 units: 6,000,000 / 15,000 = 400.

Gross domestic product (GDP) is the market value of all goods and services produced in a country in one year. Its growth shows that the economy is expanding, but GDP per capita is a better guide to how well people actually live.

According to the law of supply and demand, buyers purchase less when the price rises, while producers offer more. The point where the two curves cross sets the equilibrium price (P) and the equilibrium quantity (Q).

A cash report has three parts: the opening balance (2,500,000 soums), receipts (14,300,000 soums) and payments (12,900,000 soums). The closing balance is therefore 3,900,000 soums; compare it with the bank statement every month.

Diversification reduces risk: instead of putting all your money into one project, you spread it across several. For example, 40% of 100 million soums could go to the main business, 30% to a deposit, 20% to shares and 10% to a reserve fund.

In team projects, the RACI method assigns roles: R (Responsible) does the work, A (Accountable) owns the result, C (Consulted) gives advice and I (Informed) is kept up to date. It answers the question "Who does what?" clearly.

A bakery bakes 600 loaves a day. Each loaf costs 2,500 soums to make and sells for 4,000 soums, so it earns 1,500 soums per loaf, 900,000 soums per day and 27,000,000 soums in 30 days (before taxes and wages).
